name: proxybar
description: A lightweight macOS and Windows tray proxy switcher built with Tauri.

scripts.check: node scripts/fetch-sing-box.mjs host && npm run build:web && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.test: node scripts/fetch-sing-box.mjs host && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
